what_i_did: No turnaround exists for the fern, so the hero is the only target. make_views.py keys mj/fern/hero.png into views/hero.png: the soft cast shadow is olive-grey rather than a plain darkening of the cream, so below row 1440 pixels whose blue is more than half their green are dropped (the fern itself is far more saturated), and below row 1620 only the crown's foot is kept, which removes the dark shadow streak running out to the left.

hero_check.py renders front-on (yaw 0) from 8 deg up with the harness lens, per the art director's matched-camera note. An elevation calibration (0-20 deg) put 4 and 8 deg within 0.01 of each other, so 8 deg was held fixed. The hero IoU is the score for this job.

18 fronds in four rings from a 5 cm crown: 2 upright centre fronds, 5 high arches that rise nearly vertically and fall over to mid height, 6 lower arches whose tips droop to the ground, and 6 short skirt fronds that fill the lower mass. Each rachis follows a smooth arc whose direction falls from base to tip as s^p; the arcs were fitted to the hero's crest and tip positions. A twist towards the tip (25 deg) keeps hanging tips from going fully edge-on.

Each frond is one saw-tooth ribbon per side: 7 pinnae, a tip vertex per pinna leaning towards the frond tip and a deep notch vertex between pinnae, fanned to the rachis (19 triangles per side). Pinnae shrink towards the tip and sag a little off the blade plane, so the frond has a shallow gutter. The bottom 16 % is a bare stipe. The rachis is a thin Stem_Green strip raised just above the blade, from the ground to the tip.

Leaf_FernDark: 12 short dark blades lying almost flat around the base plus a low 7-sided faceted mound, so the foot reads as a dense dark crown as in the hero and the bottom of the silhouette is solid.

967 triangles (budget 1k), 4 meshes with one flat double-sided material each: Leaf_Fern, Leaf_FernLight (upper and centre fronds), Leaf_FernDark (crown), Stem_Green (rachises). The clump is scaled to the old WW-046.glb box: 0.85 x 0.87 x 0.53 m, origin at the footprint centre on the ground. No animation, no variants (plant group). to_game.py fern ran cleanly.
good: Hero IoU 0.644 (768 px, 48 samples): fountain clump with an upright centre, arches on both sides and tips falling towards the ground, wider than tall like the hero.
Same box as the old model (0.85 x 0.87 x 0.53 m), so it drops into the tile without rescaling, at 967 triangles (old: 476).
Material names carry the game roles: three Leaf_* greens and Stem_Green, all recoloured by seasons.
off: The hero's pinnae are long, separate, serrated leaflets; mine are one saw-tooth ribbon per side, so up close the fronds look more like fir sprigs than lacy fern. At tile scale (a few pixels) this is not visible.

The hero's left side has two big high arches reaching the far edge at 75-85 % height; mine fall a little lower and closer in, and the IoU is noisy (+-0.02) with the random seed because each frond's azimuth moves.
Fronds that point at the camera are foreshortened, so the centre of the clump is a little less dense than the hero's solid mass.
The rachis strip is barely visible except on the upright centre fronds.

rounds.change: First build: 15 fronds in 3 rings, narrow blades (half-width 0.15-0.17 of length), shallow saw-tooth. 915 tris.
Blades nearly twice as wide (0.27-0.29), 16 fronds, less sag. Fronds still too low and splayed.
Steeper starts and deeper notches; no gain (arches crested too low).
Per-ring arc power, arcs fitted to the hero's crest/tip positions (rise nearly vertical, fall late).
Four rings: 2 centre, 5 high arches, 6 low arches, 5-6 short skirt fronds for the lower mass; 7 pinnae per side.
Tip twist, yellower olive greens matched to the hero, longer skirt.
Bigger dark crown (mound and blades), taller centre fronds.
Crown blades lie nearly flat and reach further, filling the bottom of the silhouette.
Sweeps over seed, notch, sag, twist and ring shapes: wider blades (0.30-0.33) were the only clear gain; seed 7; deeper notches (0.12) for a more feathery look at equal score.
Final 768 px / 48 sample render and score; to_game.py fern.

moving_parts: None. The game poses and sways plants itself; export_animations=False.
creative_additions: A short skirt of fronds and flat dark crown blades so the clump sits solidly on the ground, and a slight twist towards each frond tip so drooping tips still show their face.
